title: No-sudo self-hosted VM blocked by gh-aw compiler and setup commands
symptoms: sudo -n fails removing root-owned /tmp/gh-aw during setup or cleanup
Copilot or threat-detect installer calls sudo because the compiled command lacks --rootless
MCP gateway or safeoutputs container cannot read runner-owned mode 0600 config
conditions: Shared self-hosted Linux VM without passwordless sudo; not ARC/DinD and runner.topology is unset
Concurrent runners have separate work directories but share /tmp/gh-aw
Compiled install_copilot_cli.sh or install_threat_detect_binary.sh commands lack --rootless
Reported with gh-aw 1.0.1 and AWF v0.29.0; AWF already preserves the runner primary GID
rootCause: These are gh-aw compiler/setup behaviors, not AWF runtime defects. Merged gh-aw#75443 fixes the confirmed safeoutputs child-container identity omission while preserving owner-only config permissions; #75445 adds runner.installation and #75446 adds automatic rootless fallback when passwordless sudo is unavailable. The reported gateway failure remains unverified because the v1.0.1 gateway generator already emits --user ${MCP_GATEWAY_UID}:${MCP_GATEWAY_GID}; reconcile it with the original lock and compiler metadata. Merged #75444 improves unprivileged cleanup but leaves legacy /tmp/gh-aw cleanup and full per-run private runtime-root isolation unresolved. Keep release bounds unknown.

probe.command: for installer in install_copilot_cli.sh install_threat_detect_binary.sh; do printf '%s total/rootless:\n' "$installer"; grep -h -F -- "$installer" .github/workflows/*.lock.yml | awk 'BEGIN { total = 0; rootless = 0 } { total++; if (index($0, "--rootless")) rootless++ } END { print total, rootless }'; done
probe.expect: For each installer, compare total matching command lines with those carrying --rootless. A smaller rootless count identifies commands to inspect on a no-sudo runner, not proof of a cleanup or container-identity defect. Only names and counts are printed; no files are changed. The 2026-11-08 scan reported 81 Copilot and 17 threat-detect installs with zero --rootless matches; counts are snapshot evidence, not invariants.

action: On gh-aw revisions containing PRs #75445 and #75446, set runner.installation: rootless when rootless installation is required; #75446 also falls back to rootless installation when passwordless sudo is unavailable. PR #75443 fixes the confirmed safeoutputs child identity omission; retain mode 0600 config permissions. These changes do not establish that shared /tmp/gh-aw cleanup or full per-run private runtime-root isolation is resolved: #75444 leaves legacy cleanup and runtime-path migration incomplete. Verify the compiled lock and compiler metadata, keep release bounds unknown, and reconcile any reported gateway identity failure with the original artifact because the v1.0.1 generator already emits --user. Do not add passwordless sudo or widen permissions, and do not treat a renamed shared directory as run-scoped isolation.
